name: Player Account and Authentication Service
description: Single sign-on, session issuance and account recovery for every player across all titles.
dependencies: GAME-AST-005 (entitlement lookup); GAME-AST-010 (staff SSO for support tooling)
existing_controls: MFA enforced for staff; breached-password screening at registration; login rate limiting; hardware-backed session tokens.

name: Launcher and Content Delivery Network
description: Game launcher, patch distribution and regional content delivery for desktop titles.
dependencies: GAME-AST-011 (edge points of presence); GAME-AST-009 (signed build artefacts)
existing_controls: Code signing of every published artefact; integrity manifest verified by the client; CDN origin locked to the release pipeline.

name: Gameplay and Matchmaking Services
description: Authoritative game servers, matchmaking and session state for live multiplayer titles.
existing_controls: Server-authoritative game logic; input validation on every RPC; anomaly detection on match outcomes.

name: Player Telemetry and Data Warehouse
description: Aggregated player behaviour, progression and retention data used by analytics and machine learning.
existing_controls: Encryption at rest; row-level access controls; quarterly access review; immutable audit of exports.

name: Payments and Virtual Currency Ledger
description: Storefront checkout, in-game currency balances and the entitlement ledger.
existing_controls: PCI DSS scoped network; dual control on settlement keys; tokenised card data; velocity fraud rules.

name: Live Operations Telemetry Pipeline
description: Streaming ingestion of match telemetry that feeds balance tuning and live events.
existing_controls: Schema validation on ingest; back-pressure alerting; replayable event log.

name: Anti-Cheat and Trust Service
description: Client integrity attestation, cheat detection and player report triage.
existing_controls: Client integrity attestation; signed telemetry; heuristic scoring with manual review before bans.

name: Player Support Desk
description: Hosted ticketing and live chat platform used by Player Support agents.
existing_controls: Contractual security schedule; single sign-on only; annual vendor assessment; least-privilege agent roles.

name: Build Pipeline and Release Signing
description: Continuous integration, artefact promotion and the code-signing keys for shipped builds.
existing_controls: Separated build and release roles; signing keys held in an HSM; approved-change gate on production release.

name: Studio Identity Provider
description: Staff identity, conditional access and privileged access workstations.
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA; conditional access policies; privileged access workstations; monitored break-glass accounts.

name: Regional Edge Network
description: Edge points of presence, peering and traffic steering for low-latency gameplay.
existing_controls: Anycast routing; DDoS scrubbing at the edge; peering restricted to approved partners.

name: Age Verification and Compliance Service
description: Age assurance, parental controls and regional content gating.
existing_controls: Documented age-assurance rules per region; parental consent capture; retention limits on identity documents.

name: Marketing Analytics and User Acquisition Platform
description: Campaign attribution, spend optimisation and cohort reporting.
existing_controls: Pseudonymised identifiers; consent gating; third-party tag review before release.

name: QA Test Environment
description: Shared test estate used for regression and platform compatibility testing.
existing_controls: Test data is masked or synthetic; test accounts are time-boxed; no production credentials are stored.
